prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one small flat diagonal costume-and-limb rig component
Primary request: Create exactly one elongated straight tapered panel from a wider solid upper-left joint cap to a narrower solid lower-right joint cap. The centerline is straight and the shape is one connected physical piece.
Color layout from upper-left to lower-right: short solid pale-peach overlap; short visible pale-peach section; one narrow dark navy band with one tiny flat gold four-point mark on the screen-right side; long matte-white fitted fabric section with one hard pale-lilac shadow strip; short solid matte-white overlap cap.
Rigging geometry: one continuous closed panel with broad solid rounded caps at both ends and 15 percent overlap at each end for adjacent layers. Keep the lower-right end filled and flat.
Rendering: restrained anime cel-animation cut piece using only closed flat color regions, crisp hard boundaries, and a thin cool-gray closed outline. Every visible mark lies within this single component.
Composition/framing: exactly one complete panel centered and uncropped on a square canvas, occupying about 18 percent of width and 48 percent of height, with very broad unused margins.
Constraints: one component and one view only; no pair, duplicate, hollow end, ring, opening, bent joint, extra appendage, torso, skirt, complete character, detached mark, extra object, stand, floor, scenery, text, logo, signature, watermark, sprite sheet, atlas, turnaround, panel grid, or inset.
